author: vivirancy
name: moderation
short: Ban, kick, warn, with better action verification and modlog integration.
description: Ban, kick, warn, with better action verification. All actions give proper verification / feedback so you can feel confident in your actions. Cases are recorded through vivi-cogs/ModLog when it is installed, and fall back to Red's core modlog when it is not. When ModLog is installed, its `[p]modlogchannels` command routes these cases to their own channels.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any data itself. It records moderation cases through vivi-cogs/ModLog when that cog is installed, and through Red's core modlog otherwise; either way the ID of the member acted on is stored in that case entry and retained by whichever modlog recorded it.
